summary: A registered transfer agent with long experience in tokenization and digital-asset custody supports modernization and urges 'functional accountability': regulating the authoritative securities state and the accountable registered transfer agent, rather than any particular technology. Its principal recommendations are to define 'exclusive control' at the level of authoritative ownership state rather than network ownership; allow multiple linked systems under one accountable agent; keep humans and regulated institutions responsible for interpretation, delegation and exceptions while permitting machine execution within set limits; prevent wallets, smart contracts or software agents from acquiring legal authority merely by technical capability; calibrate turnaround metrics; and scale compliance to risk instead of preserving the Rule 17ad-4 exemption unchanged. This is the commenter's position, not an SEC or TitleChain Foundation conclusion.
